plugins.name: android-runner
plugins.description: Android Device Runner for ZCode: a side panel for devices, build, install, launch and logcat, with zero-config detection of the Gradle project, adb, SDK and JDK. Port of the Android Device Runner VS Code extension.

description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 侧栏面板:跟随当前窗口的工程,设备/编译/安装/启动/日志一键操作;工程、SDK、JDK、adb 全自动探测,签名不一致自动替换。
description_i18n.en: ZCode side panel: devices, build, install, launch and logcat for the project of the current window. Zero-config detection of Gradle, adb, SDK and JDK.
